name: The Inner Sanctum

faq.answer: Valennia Stormfist is a commander leading an assault into the depths of the Shrine of Akir. She spearheaded the breach into the inner sanctum with her forces, though the fierce clash inside abruptly subsided into an ominous silence.
The Shrine of Akir houses an inner sanctum currently under assault. Valennia's troops breached its defenses amidst heavy fighting, making it the center of a tense and deadly confrontation.
faq.q: What is the Shrine of Akir?

faq.answer: Heavy combat echoed from within immediately following the breach, but the sounds of battle ceased suddenly. An unsettling calm settled over the inner sanctum, leaving allies outside to fear that Valennia's vanguard may have been overwhelmed or wiped out.
faq.q: What happened to Valennia's forces inside?

faq.answer: Valennia survives the assault, but she is found gravely wounded inside the inner sanctum of the Shrine of Akir after the fighting subsides.

The inner sanctum is the deepest chamber within the Shrine of Akir. The mission directs an ally to enter the chamber alone, assess the aftermath of the breach, and make contact with Valennia and any surviving fighters.
faq.q: What is the objective inside the inner sanctum?

faq.answer: An ally watching the rear outside the inner sanctum sends you in. While holding the perimeter to watch your back, they send you forward to link up with Valennia's vanguard.
faq.q: Who sends you into the inner sanctum?

sections.body: Following an intense assault, Valennia Stormfist led her detachment to breach the inner sanctum within the Shrine of Akir. The initial clash produced sounds of thick, desperate fighting from deep within the chambers, but the noise soon gave way to an unsettling, abrupt silence that left allies outside bracing for the worst.
sections.title: A Sudden Silence

sections.body: Venturing into the quieted sanctum reveals the grim cost of the assault. Rather than a victorious vanguard securing the position, Valennia Stormfist is discovered gravely wounded in the aftermath of the battle, with the fate of her vanguard left precariously in question.
sections.title: The Cost of the Breach

summary: The Inner Sanctum centers on a perilous reconnaissance into the deepest chamber of the Shrine of Akir. After Valennia Stormfist and her strike force breached the sanctum amidst heavy fighting, an eerie silence fell over the area, prompting an urgent mission to discover if any survivors remain.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Inner Sanctum
